newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian, French, Dutch police in drugs bust.
newsitem.headline: Belgian, French, Dutch police in drugs bust.

text.p: Belgian, French and Dutch police arrested 11 people in a major drugs raid on Belgium's borders this weekend, police said on Sunday.
Belgian police told VTM television that 2,300 police officers from the three countries had checked all car and train traffic for drugs traffickers from Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning.
More than 250 people were found to carry drugs, of whom 174 were Belgian, 31 Dutch and 51 French. Most had only small quantities of cannabis. Eleven were arrested.
Many French and Belgian cannabis users obtain their supplies in the Netherlands, where it can be freely bought in so-called coffee shops.
